project.title: Serviceable electronics enclosure with organic owl façade

coordinate_frame.origin: rear-bottom-left corner of the chassis outer envelope

requirements.statement: The enclosure shall open and the PCB shall be removable without damaging the organic façade.
requirements.verification: exploded assembly and repeated service test

requirements.statement: Generated ornament shall not reduce the parametric intake/exhaust free area or block the fan swept volume.
requirements.verification: exact keep-out collision, free-area calculation, and temperature test

requirements.statement: The replaceable façade shall depict an Art Nouveau owl surrounding, but not defining, the display and vent openings.
requirements.verification: matched concept views and trim preview

global_style.summary: Art Nouveau owl façade with broad feather arcs framing functional openings
exclude: literal holes used as final vents
global_style.detail_hierarchy: outer owl silhouette, eye/brow masses, broad feathers, sparse shallow lines

assembly_sequence: Install PCB, fan, display, and cable hardware into CHASSIS and verify service/tool paths.
Slide FRONT_BACKER into CHASSIS and secure its stop.
Attach OWL_FACADE to FRONT_BACKER after fit and adhesive-gap coupon approval.
Remove FRONT_BACKER with OWL_FACADE intact for future service.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the electronics, connector, cable, and thermal envelopes.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Supplier drawings, measured samples, cable bend radius, and worst-case thermal test plan.

decision_log.topic: Approve the owl facade generation plates and protected silhouette.
decision_log.current_basis: The written concept defines style but no approved source plates exist.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Approved orthographic plates, review render, masks, and landmark check.

components.name: Parametric electronics chassis
components.role: structural enclosure, PCB/fan mounts, rear connectors, thermal and service authority

manufacturing.orientation: chosen for rails, heat, and support-free vents

components.name: Parametric removable front and façade backer
components.role: display/vent opening authority, sliding interface, exact organic seat, and service boundary

manufacturing.orientation: front face upward or edge-on after surface/rail comparison

components.name: Organic replaceable owl façade
components.role: customer-selectable appearance body around parametric openings
functions: frame display and vent without defining them

manufacturing.material: PLA or PETG after enclosure-temperature review

image_to_3d.positive_prompt: One coherent shallow Art Nouveau owl façade, symmetrical brow and eye masses, broad layered feather arcs, quiet flat rear root and quiet margins around two marked future opening zones, matte neutral clay, printable medium-scale detail.
negative_spaces: rough eye/display and lower vent zones remain visually quiet for later parametric cutting

components.name: Purchased PCB, fan, display, and connectors
components.role: purchased functional assembly and authoritative clearance/tool envelopes

nominal_geometry.type: two vertical dovetail rails plus bottom stop
planar backer with three keys and bounded adhesive channel

joining.method: keys locate; controlled adhesive gap retains

requirements.load_or_flow: appearance retention only; vent/display remain parametric

nominal_geometry.type: supplier mounting holes, standoffs, fan/display/connector envelopes

requirements.load_or_flow: PCB/fan support, airflow, cable and service access

keepouts.purpose: coarse electronics occupancy; exact supplier bodies live in CAD
coarse fan/vent free-area proxy; exact duct and swept fan body live in CAD

validation.acceptance: chassis/front own all function; façade is replaceable appearance

validation.method: assemble chassis, front, COTS, tool, vent, and façade envelopes
validation.acceptance: no trapped electronics or blocked air/service path

validation.method: façade mesh intake, landmarks, silhouette, and quiet-opening zones
validation.acceptance: one coherent body within envelope and with sufficient sacrificial back

validation.method: rail/key/gap sections, trim, keep-out, and surface-preservation checks
slice chassis/front/façade with named profiles and inspect support/material boundaries
validation.acceptance: rails, vents, detail, and separate bodies slice as intended

validation.method: rail coupon, key/adhesive coupon, service cycles, thermal test, then enclosure prototype
validation.acceptance: fit, access, retention, and temperature targets pass
